runSummary.note: Fresh 11.9.2026 04:45 sweep genuinely searched Profesia, direct-company career discovery, LinkedIn Jobs, Worki, Brigada.sk, Kariera/Zoznam, Pretlak, Upwork, Reddit/public WordPress communities and public Facebook indexing. No new unique candidate cleared the hard location, language, skill, economics and activity gates. Profesia surfaced 3MON Office Manager/Executive Support in Bratislava with e-shop order processing and customer/admin work, but the canonical detail requires 3 years of similar practice plus advanced Word/Excel, so it remains verification-only rather than LIVE promotion. LinkedIn public results were mainly Wolt shift/student roles, older Staffino support/project coordination, and SupportYourApp roles with fluent/C1 English. Upwork surfaced Worldwide WordPress/WooCommerce/VA roles, but accessible options were low-budget, development-heavy, English-heavy, portfolio-heavy or otherwise weak on economics. Facebook yielded 0 concrete publicly verifiable hiring posts.
